item.text:
**Assessment:** Mostly no. I found no credible evidence that Scholz used internet shutdowns, broad digital controls, or routine administrative harassment to suppress political freedom in 2024. The main counterweight is a structural one: Germany still had an overbroad intelligence/surveillance framework with weak oversight, and there was at least one serious security leak that triggered investigation. That is a system-level problem, not proof of a targeted repression campaign by Scholz.

| Direction | Title | Publisher | Date | Recoverable URL | Claim-level summary | Question IDs |
|---|---|---:|---|---|---|---|
| Supportive | Germany’s first National Security Strategy | Federal Government | 2024 archive page, strategy adopted 2023 | https://www.bundesregierung.de/breg-en/aktuelles/national-security-strategy-2196356 | Scholz presented the security strategy as a broad, prevention-oriented whole-of-government approach covering diplomacy, police, civil protection, cyber security, supply chains, and pandemic prevention. That points to institutional risk management, not politicized coercion or suppression of political activity. | 4B.9, 4B.4 |
| Supportive | Scholz opens conference on Germany’s security situation | Bundesregierung | 2024-06-06 | https://www.bundesregierung.de/breg-de/suche/scholz-sicherheitslage-2291096 | Scholz said Germany’s security authorities were carefully prepared, framed safety as a core state duty, and emphasized warning systems and coordinated disaster response. This is a rule-of-law security posture rather than administrative harassment. | 4B.9, 4B.4 |
| Supportive | Scholz says Germany would not accept foreign spying | Reuters via Investing.com | 2024-04-24 | https://uk.investing.com/news/world-news/germany-cannot-accept-spying-says-scholz-after-suspected-china-spy-arrested-3451540 | Scholz called for prosecution of those responsible while avoiding prejudgment during legal proceedings. That is due-process language, not arbitrary intimidation of political opponents or critics. | 4B.9, 4B.5 |
| Supportive | Scholz praises free, independent, diverse media | Bundesregierung | 2024-06-03 | https://www.bundesregierung.de/breg-de/service/newsletter-und-abos/bulletin/scholz-journalistenschule-2290636 | Scholz explicitly praised independent journalism, investigative reporting, and critical distance as essential to democracy. This cuts against a pattern of propaganda pressure or hostility toward independent information channels. | 4B.9, 4B.6 |
| Supportive | Scholz at the summer press conference | Federal Government | 2024-07-24 | https://www.bundesregierung.de/breg-en/service/archive/chancellor-summer-press-conference-2024-2301040 | Scholz took extensive public questions from journalists rather than insulating himself from scrutiny. That is basic accountability behavior, not a control tactic. | 4B.9, 4B.6 |
| Supportive | Scholz protects free speech at SPD rally | Euronews / AP | 2024-06-09 | https://www.euronews.com/my-europe/2024/06/09/german-chancellor-olaf-scholz-heckled-by-pro-palestinian-protesters-at-spd-rally | Scholz said protesters were part of a democracy that allows free speech and that freedom of speech must be protected. He condemned violence, but did not treat the protest itself as illegitimate. | 4B.9, 4B.6, 4B.7 |
| Counterweight | BND surveillance ruling | Bundesverfassungsgericht | 2024-11-08 | https://www.bundesverfassungsgericht.de/SharedDocs/Pressemitteilungen/EN/2024/bvg24-093.html | The Constitutional Court found parts of the BND surveillance framework unconstitutional and said oversight was inadequate. This is the strongest structural negative for political-freedom protection, but it is not proof Scholz personally used surveillance to repress opponents. | 4B.9, 4B.4, 4B.5 |
| Counterweight | Germany’s response to leaked Taurus call | AP | 2024-03-04 | https://apnews.com/article/russia-germany-ukraine-taurus-missiles-recording-de408772f1edf3bd2f98fd5a3f64da3c | The defense ministry treated the intercepted call as a security incident and investigated it, then moved to counter disinformation. This was a real security lapse, but the response was institutional correction, not political repression. | 4B.9, 4B.4 |
| Counterweight | Berlin funding clause criticism | Euronews | 2024-01-24 | https://www.euronews.com/culture/2024/01/24/art-world-accusing-german-government-of-choking-pro-palestinian-speech | This is indirect evidence that some observers believed state funding rules chilled pro-Palestinian expression. It is a real warning sign, but it does not show Scholz personally ordered censorship or administrative harassment. | 4B.9, 4B.6, 4B.7 |

**Search gap**
- I did not find reliable evidence of internet shutdowns, mass digital throttling, or systematic administrative harassment directed by Scholz in 2024.
- The available evidence points instead to normal democratic transparency, some precautionary digital-security regulation, and one major structural oversight defect in intelligence law.
- The best negative evidence is institutional rather than personal: an overbroad surveillance framework remained in place, but not a clear repression campaign by the chancellor.
